description.translate: The old furnace didn't just break. It buckled from the inside, like something had pushed against the walls. Never seen heat do that. I need sixteen bricks to repair the foundation. Bring them here, and I'll tell you what happened that night.

These will do. We were testing the Warden's call stored in Tears for Fears. The Ranker pushed the apparatus past Voss's marked limit. The fire was nearly out when the fittings began to shake; then the test frame buckled into the furnace. That force came from the blade. Voss kept the readings.
